title: Suction gripper for a handling device

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference mentions a vacuum connection and a vacuum device, but does not specify it is electrically operated or located within a housing.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a suction plate (Saugplatte 1) with a circumferential seal (umlaufenden Dichtung 5) on its inner side.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a suction gripper (Sauggreifer) for a handling device (Handhabungsvorrichtung), which implies a combination of a gripping unit and a suction plate.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a vacuum connection (Vakuumanschluss) for connecting the inside of the suction plate within the circumferential seal (Saugtasche) to a vacuum device (Vakuumeinrichtung).

claims.note: The reference describes a suction gripper for handling workpieces, but not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.
The reference describes a suction gripper with a vacuum connection to a vacuum device, but not a housing with a grip portion and an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
The reference describes a suction gripper but does not mention a sound-damping device arranged in a grip portion.
The reference does not describe a grip portion lined with a sound-damping material.
The reference does not describe a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
The reference does not mention a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.

The reference describes a suction gripper with a suction plate and a vacuum connection, but it does not mention a grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions, nor an air outlet on a second housing portion.
The reference describes a suction gripper, but it does not mention an air collection device, an air collection screw, or the collection of exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.
The reference describes a suction gripper, but it does not mention air baffles, bent or curved, arranged downstream of a grip portion for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.

The reference describes a suction gripper, but it does not mention a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
(non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a suction gripper for a handling device for handling workpieces with a vacuum connection to a vacuum device.
(non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a suction plate with a circumferential seal on the inside and a vacuum connection.
The reference describes a suction gripper, but does not mention a 'grip unit according to claim 1'.
The reference describes a suction gripper with a suction plate, but it does not mention a grip unit or a coupling device for releasably connecting the grip unit and the suction plate.

(non-English passage at abstract) The reference discloses a suction plate with a vacuum connection to a vacuum device, forming a suction pocket (Saugtasche) to generate a vacuum. However, it does not explicitly mention a 'grip unit' with a 'suction opening' that is fluidically connected to a suction chamber.

overall.why: The reference describes a suction gripper with a suction plate and a seal, which are core elements of the subject invention. However, it lacks details regarding the housing, grip portion, vacuum generating device's electrical operation, and sound-damping features.
